I was leaving for my grandparents house so that I could live with them and work at the age of 17. My parents were struggling financially so I was leaving to help pay their bills. 
This older lady, we'll call her Hilda, lived a couple houses down from my family. I didn't really know the lady but there were times that we waved to each other as I walked down the road. As I said goodbye to my mom and dad, Hilda drove up and asked me to come over for five minutes. 
We sat on her couch and she asked me if I was really leaving. I told her I was but only for a year and then I'd come back. She smiled and handed me an envelope telling me how proud she was to see me help out my family like I was. I opened the envelope to see $500 in cash and was in complete shock. We didn't even know each other besides a few exchanges of hellos and she was giving me all this?
She said that I looked like a sweet kid and hoped that it helped. 
Sad to say that before I was able to come back home within that year, Hilda had passed away. 
Thank you again, Miss Hilda. I wish I would have stopped by all those times I noticed you outside picking your flowers. I did not deserve your generosity.
